description: The Xinjiang Institute of Ecology and Geography provides global gridded cooling and heating degree days derived from ERA5-Land two-metre air temperature. The published period is 1981 to 2023 at 0.1-degree resolution, excluding Antarctica in the describing article. Science Data Bank lists one downloadable archive under CC BY 4.0; the article describes separate cooling and heating NetCDF products inside it. Building-energy and electricity-demand simulations can use the grids to compare climate-driven cooling and heating requirements between regions or years. The degree-day measures summarize temperature relative to thresholds and are not measured electricity or fuel consumption. The authors compare their computed values with Global Surface Summary of the Day stations, reporting determination coefficients of 0.84 for cooling and 0.97 for heating. That broad check does not establish accuracy at a particular building or grid cell. The article gives inconsistent compressed and component sizes, so file size is not asserted here. No archive or numerical values were downloaded. The catalogued ERA5 reanalysis is related upstream climate context; this deposit supplies derived demand indicators. Coverage and threshold conventions should be checked before using local simulation inputs.
